headline: Questions Raised Over Major Venezuela Oil Deal
summary: Doubts have emerged over a massive Venezuelan oil deal involving North American Blue Energy Partners, as experts cite steep development challenges.
why: Venezuela possesses the world's largest proven crude oil reserves, though operational and political challenges heavily influence production capacity.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Uncertainty surrounding the execution of Venezuelan crude development impacts global energy supply expectations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
